verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair axis for an AI app builder, but every documented workflow in Figma Make runs through its interactive chat, preview and canvas UI. There is no CLI, API or CI integration in the pack. A community report even says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, which forced users to reverse-engineer the format, and probes found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
